name: Devil Lord
description: A devil lord is a powerful entity from the infernal plane, known for commanding legions and binding souls through dark pacts. Cloaked in shadow and armed with ruthless cunning, it uses both magic and manipulation to bend others to its will. A Devil Lord is as deadly in negotiation as it is in direct combat, exploiting every rule to its advantage.

actions.name: Demon Claws
actions.description: The devil lord swipes with it's claws at a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Dire Charm
actions.description: The devil lord attempts to charm a creature within 8 units for the next minute or until naturally broken. This action requires the devil lord's focus.

actions.name: Discard
actions.description: The devil lord ends their focus on the Dire Charm action prematurely, dealing unavoidable psychic damage to the target. This damage increase by 2d8 for each round the creature has been charmed.

actions.name: Flame Whip
actions.description: The devil lord whips a target with strands of flame, dealing fire damage. On a true hit, the whip wraps around the targets neck, muting them until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Ignite Hellfire
actions.description: The devil lord targets a flame within a 1 unit area or an ignited creature within 10 units and converts it to hellfire.

actions.name: Metamorphosis
actions.description: The devil lord transforms themselves into a Malgaroth. This form lasts until it reaches 0 health, at which point the devil lord reverts to it's normal form with the health it had before the transformation. This action can only be used once per day.

actions.name: Binding Word
actions.description: In response to a creature within 8 units moving, the devil lord speaks a word in the Demonic Language, causing that creature to halt and their movement speed to become 0 until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Hellshield
actions.description: In response to a creature targeting the devil lord with a melee or projectile, the devil lord summons a shield of fire, adding a 2d4 bonus to their block check. This shield lasts until the start of the devil lord's next turn or it successfully blocks 3 attacks.

actions.name: Call Servant
actions.description: The devil lord calls forth a servant with a level of 7 or lower that appears within a space within 6 units. The servant lasts until it or the devil lord reaches 0 health. This ability costs 5 power.

traits.name: Pact Maker
traits.description: The devil lord is an entity capable of bestowing a pact with a mortal creature by using the Contract spell.

traits.name: Greater Devil
traits.description: The devil lord takes only half damage from physical sources that are not the result of a magical effect or have the blackened property.

traits.name: Flame Aura
traits.description: When in combat, any creature that ends its turn within 3 units of the devil lord takes 2d12 fire damage.
